7542.meaning: FILTERCRITERIANOTPERMITTEDFORSHAREDUSER — criteria update is not permitted for this share type.
7542.resolution: Remove or adjust the criteria field.

7543.meaning: ONLYBASETABLECOLINTABULARFILTERCRITERIA — criteria on a tabular view referenced a column outside its base table.
7543.resolution: Filter using only the base table's own columns.

7545.meaning: SHAREANDWRITEPERMISSIONSNOTALLOWEDFORROUSERS — A Read-Only/embedded user was granted share together with a write permission.
7545.resolution: Do not combine share: true with write permissions for Read-Only users.

7548.meaning: NOSUCHROLEEXIST — No role exists for the given <role-id>.
7548.resolution: Verify the ID with Get Custom Roles.

7549.meaning: CANNOTSHARETOCUSTOMROLEUSER — Attempted to share directly to a user who only has a custom-role-based org-level permission.
7549.resolution: Share via the appropriate group/role mechanism instead.

7550.meaning: The specified role name does not exist as a custom role in the org.
7550.resolution: Use "WORKSPACEADMIN", "USER", or an exact custom role name from the org.

7553.meaning: ROLENAMEEXISTS — A role with this name already exists in the organization.

7554.meaning: INVALIDVIEWTYPEGROUP — accessType did not resolve to a known level.
7554.resolution: Send one of the three documented values.

7559.meaning: EXPORTPERMNEEDEDFOREMAILSCH — manageEmailSchedules is true but export is not.

7565.meaning: UNVERIFIEDEMAIL — The calling user's primary email address is not verified.
7565.resolution: Verify the account's primary email address and retry.

7571.meaning: UNKNOWNVIEWIDPASSED — A tableCriteriaList[].viewId does not exist in this workspace.
7571.resolution: Verify the IDs with Get View List.

7573.meaning: CRDATAPERMNOTALLOWEDFORACCESSTYPE — A data permission was enabled below the full access level.
7573.resolution: Raise accessType, or set every dataPermissions flag to false.

7574.meaning: CRDESIGNPERMNOTALLOWEDFORACCESSTYPE — designModify was enabled below the full access level.

7575.meaning: CRCREATEPERMNOTALLOWEDFORACCESSTYPE — createTable, createQueryTable, or createFormula was enabled below the full access level.
7575.resolution: Raise accessType, or disable those flags. createFolder is allowed at every level.

7576.meaning: CRALERTPERMNOTALLOWEDFORACCESSTYPE — manageDataAlerts was enabled with ALLDASHBOARDS.
7576.resolution: Use ALLREPORTSANDDASHBOARDS or higher, or disable the flag.

7577.meaning: CRSCHEDULEDDATADELETIONPERMNOTALLOWED — dataArchives is true but not every data permission is enabled.
7577.resolution: Enable all data permissions, or disable dataArchives.

7578.meaning: CRDESIGNMODIFYREQUIRESPRESETPERMS — designModify is true without both preset permissions.
7578.resolution: Set accessAdminPresets and createPreset to true.

7579.meaning: CRREADPERMMUSTBEENABLED — interactionPermissions.read is missing or false.

7580.meaning: CRACCESSTYPEANDPERMSREQUIREDTOGETHER — One of accessType / permissions was sent without the other.

7581.meaning: CRNOFIELDSTOUPDATE — Neither roleName nor accessType was supplied.

7584.meaning: CRDATASOURCEPERMNOTALLOWEDFORACCESSTYPE — A datasource permission was enabled below the full access level.
7584.resolution: Raise accessType, or disable the datasource group.

7585.meaning: CRUSEDATASOURCEREQUIRESCREATETABLE — useDatasource is true but createTable is not.

7586.meaning: CRVIEWDATASOURCEREQUIREDFORDATASOURCEPERMS — Another datasource permission is enabled without viewDatasource.

7701.meaning: DROP_X_Y - The chart's shelves do not form a drawable chart; typically no X-axis or no Y-axis column.

7703.meaning: REMOVE_CLR_FIELD - Multiple Y-axis columns in a shelf combination that does not support them, typically with a colorAxis column or with no X-axis column.
7703.resolution: Drop the colour axis, add an X axis, or reduce to one Y axis.

7705.meaning: DROP_SUMMARY - A summary report has no groupBy and no summarize column.

7706.meaning: DROP_PIVOT - A pivot report has no row, column or data column.

7725.meaning: ILLEGAL_COLUMN - The caller is not permitted to access a column used in the report.
7725.resolution: Share the column with the caller, or remove it.

7727.meaning: Y_EXCEED_LIMIT - More than 15 Y-axis columns on a chart.

7801.meaning: MARGINVALUEEXCEEDS — A PDF margin is outside 0–1 inches.

7803.meaning: INVALIDDIMENSION — width or height is outside the permitted image range.

7806.meaning: XLSCELLLIMITEXCEEDS — The XLS export exceeds the per-sheet cell limit.
7806.resolution: Narrow the export with criteria or selectedColumns, or export as CSV.

7807.meaning: XLSCOLLIMITEXCEEDS — More than 256 columns were requested for an XLS export.
7807.resolution: Reduce the column count with selectedColumns, or export as CSV.

7808.meaning: XLSCELLCHARLIMITEXCEEDS — A single cell exceeds 32,767 characters.
7808.resolution: Exclude the offending column, or export as CSV.

7809.meaning: XLSNODATA — The XLS export produced no data.

7812.meaning: SCHEDULEDELETED — No schedule exists with the given <schedule-id>.
7812.resolution: Re-resolve the current ID via Get Email Schedules.

7824.meaning: EXPORTREQBLOCKED — Export has been blocked for this workspace.
7824.resolution: Contact Zoho Analytics support using the address in the error message.

7827.resolution: Narrow the export with criteria or selectedColumns, or choose a non-paginated format.

7830.meaning: EXPALLRECORDLIMIT — The exported payload exceeds 100 MB.
7830.resolution: Split the export with criteria, or use the asynchronous export.

7832.meaning: INVALIDEXPORTTYPE — exportType is not one of the supported formats.
7832.resolution: Use CSV, XLS, PDF, HTML, or IMG.

7835.meaning: NOTABLESINVOLVEDINSQLEXPORT — The statement references no table.
7835.resolution: Query at least one table of the workspace.

7836.meaning: GIVENTABLENOTINVOLVEDINSQLEXPORT — A tableCriteriaList[].viewId is not used by the statement.
7836.resolution: List only tables the query actually references.

7837.meaning: INVOLVEDTABLEDOESNOTHAVEPERMISSION — A table used by the query has no matching tableCriteriaList entry where one is required.
7837.resolution: Supply a criteria entry for every participating table.

7929.meaning: The view has already been restored from trash.
7929.resolution: The view is no longer in trash. No action needed.

7941.meaning: The view has parent dependencies that are also in trash and must be restored together.
7941.resolution: Retry with "withDependents": true in the CONFIG. See Appendix D for details.

7942.meaning: The view has child dependent views in trash that must be deleted together.
7942.resolution: Retry with "withDependents": true in the CONFIG. See Appendix D for details.

7943.meaning: The requesting user does not have permission to restore this specific trashed view.
7943.resolution: Only the view's original owner or an admin can restore it.

7951.meaning: The organisation has reached its workspace creation limit based on the current subscription plan.
7951.resolution: Upgrade the plan or delete unused workspaces before creating a new one.

8000.meaning: DUPLICATESCHEDULE — A schedule with this scheduleName already exists in the workspace.

8001.meaning: INVALIDRESPFORMAT — responseFormat is not a supported value.
8001.resolution: Send one of csv, json, xml, xls, pdf, html, image.

8002.meaning: SCHMAILACTIONNOTSUPPORTED — The schedule is not in this workspace, or the caller may not act on it.
8002.resolution: Verify the ID belongs to this workspace.

8003.meaning: ALLSCHRUNERROR — The schedule could not be activated.
8003.resolution: Check that the schedule's views still exist and that the organization is within its schedule quota.

8004.meaning: ALLSCHPAUSEERROR — The schedule could not be deactivated.
8004.resolution: Retry; if it persists, verify the schedule still exists.

8005.meaning: SCHNOTINWS — The schedule does not belong to the specified workspace.

8008.meaning: UNKNOWN_PARAMETER - behaviour was supplied on a slider, dateRange or relative user filter.
8008.resolution: Remove behaviour from that user filter.

8009.meaning: MAILMULTIVIEWMAXCOUNTEXCEEEDED — Too many views in one schedule.
8009.resolution: Reduce viewIds, or split across schedules.

8014.meaning: APIIMAGERESPONSENOTPOSSIBLE — image was requested for a view that is not a chart.
8014.resolution: Export charts as images; use pdf or html for tables and reports.

8015.meaning: APIEXPORTCOLUMNNOTPRESENT — A name in selectedColumns does not match any column in the view.
8015.resolution: Check the display names with Get Columns.

8016.meaning: APINOCOLUMNPRESENT — None of the supplied column names matched a column in the table.
8016.resolution: Check the names via Get Columns.

8017.meaning: INVALIDIMAGEFORMAT — imageFormat is not png, jpg, or jpeg.
8017.resolution: Send one of the three supported values.

8021.meaning: INVALID_VIEW_TYPE_IN_REQUEST - The target is a table, query table or dashboard, not a report.

8023.meaning: OEMOPERATIONNOTALLOWED — The organization/workspace is not enabled for Embedded Analytics.
8023.resolution: Embedded Analytics must be enabled for the account; contact Zoho Analytics support/sales.

8024.meaning: Cross-org copy attempted without a valid workspaceKey, or the provided key does not match the source workspace's secret key.
8024.resolution: Obtain the correct workspaceKey from the source workspace owner using Get Workspace Secret Key, then retry. For same-org copies, omit workspaceKey.

8027.meaning: One or more VIEW cards name a view that does not exist in this workspace, or viewName is absent / null / non-string.
8027.resolution: Check the view display names. Matching is case-insensitive but the view must exist.

8029.meaning: SHAREINVALIDEMAILADDRESS — One or more emailIds entries is not a valid email address.

8030.meaning: EMAILEXPORTDISABLEDINORG — Email export is disabled for this organization.
8030.resolution: Ask the Organization Admin to enable export in Security Controls.

8031.meaning: UNTRUSTEDEMAILIDS — A recipient address is outside the organization's trusted domains.
8031.resolution: Supply either a viewIds array or set removeAllViews: true.

8032.meaning: VIEWNOTSHARED — The view is not currently shared with the specified user.
8032.resolution: Check the view's and workspace's export settings.

8033.meaning: MAILSCHSELECTATLEASTONEEMAILID — No recipient could be resolved from emailIds, groupIds, and cc.
8033.resolution: Supply at least one address or a non-empty group.

8034.meaning: ONLYONEDASHBOARDISALLOWEDPERSCH — More than one view scheduled where the first is a dashboard.
8034.resolution: Schedule the dashboard on its own.

8035.meaning: EXPORTFORMATSALLOWEDFORDASHBOARD — Dashboard scheduled with a format other than PDF/HTML.

8036.meaning: EXPORTFORMATSALLOWEDFORCHART — IMG requested for a view that is not a chart.
8036.resolution: Use IMG only for chart views.

8037.meaning: ONLYONEVIEWISALLOWEDFORXLS — XLS requested with more than one view.
8037.resolution: Send exactly one view, or choose another format.

8040.meaning: One or more specified email addresses are not currently Workspace Admins in this workspace.
8040.resolution: Verify all email addresses are current Workspace Admins using Get Workspace Admins before calling this API.

8046.meaning: INVALIDCOLUMNSSELECTED — A name in selectedColumns is not present in the source data.
8046.resolution: Match the names to the source's header row.

8050.meaning: INVALID_VALUE - A value is invalid: an unknown column name; an explicit null for any key; an empty columnName; a mergeAxisInfo rule violation; mergeAxisInfo without isAxisMerge: true; isallval: false with no values; an invalid user-filter operation or filterType; exclude: true on a range-picker user filter.
8050.resolution: Check names and values against this document.

8051.meaning: VALUE_NOT_PRESENT - A mandatory key is missing: title, reportType, axisColumns, an axis type or operation, a filter's filterType, values, exclude or operation, windowFunction.type, baseFieldPosition, movingCalculation or one of its keys, a wildcard object, mergeAxisInfo[].axisIndex; or the four-key base-field lookup found no matching entry.

8052.meaning: COLUMN_COUNT_EXCEEDED - More than 1000 entries in axisColumns, filters or userFilters.

8053.meaning: AGGREGATE_COLUMN_INVALID_FIELD - In a pivot or summary report, an aggregate formula column is placed on row, column or groupBy.
8053.resolution: Place it on data or summarize.

8054.meaning: INVALIDFILTERCRITERIA — criteria could not be parsed.

8055.meaning: NUMERIC_RANKING_COLUMN - rankingColumn names a Numeric column.
8055.resolution: Use a Text or Date column.

8056.meaning: NOT_ALLOWED - pctoftotal on an average, stddev, variance, dc or distinctcount column, or on an aggregate formula.

8057.meaning: NOT_ALLOWED_BASEFIELD - windowFunction.baseField is not a dimension entry of axisColumns.
8057.resolution: Add the base field to axisColumns as a dimension.

8058.meaning: The organisation ID provided in ZANALYTICS-DEST-ORGID does not exist.
8058.resolution: Provide a valid, existing organisation ID in ZANALYTICS-DEST-ORGID.

8059.meaning: UNRELATED_TABLE - A tableName is not a table joined to the base table.
8059.resolution: Use a table reachable from the base table.

8060.meaning: DOMAIN_NOT_EXIST - The custom domain in the request host is not provisioned.
8060.resolution: Use a domain you have purchased from Zoho Analytics, or the standard API host.

8061.meaning: The specified domainName does not belong to the org's Account Admin.
8061.resolution: Use a domain name administered by the Account Admin of this organisation.

8062.meaning: ADDROWREQUESTSTILLINPROGRESS — Another row-write request for this table is still being processed.
8062.resolution: Retry after the in-flight request completes.

8074.meaning: READPERMSHOULDBETRUEFORSHARING — permissions.read was sent as false.
8074.resolution: Omit read or set it to true.

8077.meaning: EMPTY_JSON_CONFIGURATION - CONFIG is present but empty.
8077.resolution: Send a JSON object in CONFIG.

8078.meaning: EMPTYJSONATTRIBUTEFOUND — A mandatory attribute was sent blank.

8080.meaning: CONFIG is not valid JSON, was not URL-encoded correctly, contains an unsupported key, or violates a type or length constraint.
8080.resolution: Stringify and URL-encode the CONFIG object and send only the documented keys with the documented types.

8083.meaning: The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header is missing from a request that requires it.
8083.resolution: Send the organization ID in the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header. It is shown in the Zoho Analytics UI under Settings > Organisation.

8084.meaning: ORGID_NOT_EXIST - No organisation exists with the given ID.
8084.resolution: Use the orgId returned by the organisation listing API.

8085.meaning: SHAREDTOEXTERNALDOMAINNOTALLOWED — Sharing to an email outside the allowed domain(s) is disabled by org policy.
8085.resolution: Share only to users within the permitted domain(s), or contact the Org Admin to adjust the policy.

8086.meaning: SHAREDTOEXTERNALDOMAINNOTALLOWED — Sharing to an email outside the allowed domain(s) is disabled by org policy.
8086.resolution: Share only to users within the permitted domain(s), or contact the Org Admin to adjust the policy.

8088.meaning: SECURITYCONTROLSFEATUREDISABLED — Export is disabled for the organization.
8088.resolution: Ask an Organization Admin to re-enable export.

8105.meaning: REMOVESHAREALLVIEWSPRESENT — Both viewIds and removeAllViews: true were supplied together.
8105.resolution: Supply only one of the two — viewIds for a targeted removal, or removeAllViews: true alone for a bulk removal.

8114.meaning: One or more specified email addresses are not members of this organisation.
8114.resolution: Verify all email IDs using Get Users before calling this API.

8115.meaning: VIEWNOTPUBLISHEDASPRIVATE — The view has no private link.

8116.meaning: Auto analysis has already been completed for this table and analyseAgain was not set to true.
8116.resolution: Pass CONFIG={"analyseAgain":true} to re-run the analysis and replace previously generated views.

8119.meaning: INVALIDVALUEFORATTRIBUTE — fileType, onError, delimiter, quoted, thousandSeparator, or decimalSeparator is outside its permitted set.
8119.resolution: The message names the attribute and allowed values.

8120.meaning: EXPORTJOBNOTFOUND — No export job exists for the given ID (HTTP 404).
8120.resolution: Verify the jobId returned by the create call, and that the job has not passed its one-hour post-completion retention.

8121.meaning: EXPORTJOBNOTINITIATED — The job is queued but has not started (jobCode 1001).
8121.resolution: Poll Get Export Job Details until jobCode is 1004.

8122.meaning: EXPORTJOBNOTCOMPLETED — The job is still running (jobCode 1002).
8122.resolution: Poll Get Export Job Details until jobCode is 1004.

8123.resolution: Nothing to download. Create a new job; if the failure repeats, contact support.

8124.meaning: EXPORTJOBACCESSDENIED — The caller did not create this job (HTTP 403).
8124.resolution: Poll with the same user that created the job.

8125.meaning: Callback URL is malformed, unreachable, or private.

8126.meaning: Callback URL is malformed, unreachable, or private.

8127.meaning: Callback URL is malformed, unreachable, or private.

8128.meaning: INTERNALERRORONINITIATINGEXPORT — The job could not be queued.
8128.resolution: Retry; if it persists, contact support.

8130.meaning: INVALIDUPDATECRITERIACONFIGURATION — Both criteria and updateAllRows were sent, or neither was.
8130.resolution: Send exactly one of the two.

8131.meaning: INVALIDDELETECRITERIACONFIGURATION — Both criteria and deleteAllRows were sent, or neither was.
8131.resolution: Send exactly one of the two.

8132.meaning: ASYNCEXPORTLIMITEXCEEDED — 5 export jobs are already queued or running for the organization.
8132.resolution: Wait for an in-flight job to finish, then retry.

8133.meaning: SYNCEXPORTNOTALLOWED — The view is a dashboard, a query table, a live-connect view, or a table above the row limit.
8133.resolution: Use the asynchronous export API for this view.

8134.meaning: ASYNCIMPORTLIMITEXCEEDED — The maximum number of simultaneous import jobs is in progress.
8134.resolution: Wait for a running job to finish.

8137.meaning: IMPORTJOBNOTFOUND — No import job exists with this ID.
8137.resolution: Verify the jobId. Note that a job whose summary has expired is also reported as jobCode 1005.

8138.meaning: IMPORTJOBACCESSDENIED — The job was created by a different user.
8138.resolution: Poll under the same account that created the job.

8139.meaning: PASTEDDATALIMITEXCEEDED — The DATA parameter exceeds 10,000,000 characters.
8139.resolution: Send the payload as a FILE upload instead.

8144.meaning: INVALID_GRAPH_TYPE - chartType is not a value from chartType Values.
8144.resolution: Use an accepted chart type, or omit chartType.

8149.meaning: DECIMALANDTHOUSANDCOLUMNSEPARATORLEGNTHVALIDATION — A columnSeparators entry has fewer than two values.

8150.meaning: VIEWNOTSHAREDTOGROUP — The view is not currently shared with the specified group.
8150.resolution: Share the view to this group first via Share Views.

8152.meaning: INTERVALSHOULDBE120ORABOVE — autoRefresh is a positive value below 120 seconds.
8152.resolution: Use -1 to disable auto-refresh, or a value of at least 120.

8154.meaning: COLUMNNOTPRESENTINTABLE — A column in vudColumns / drillColumns (or in criteria) does not exist in the given table.
8154.resolution: Verify column names via Get Columns.

8162.meaning: RANGE_SIZE_NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_THIS_OPERATION - rangeSize was supplied on an operation other than range.

8164.meaning: FILTER_COLUMN_DATATYPE_MISMATCH - A numeric individualvalues filter value is not a valid number for the column.
8164.resolution: Send the exact stored numeric value.

8166.meaning: INVALID OPERATION FOR THE COLUMN - The operation is not valid for the column's category and shelf; or a defaultFilterValues entry is invalid.
8166.resolution: See Axis Operation Values and Static Filter Operation and Type Values.

8167.meaning: INVALID FILTER TYPE FOR THE GIVEN OPERATION - The filterType is not valid for the column category and operation.
8167.resolution: See Static Filter Operation and Type Values.

8168.meaning: INVALID CRITERIA FORMAT FOR THE COLUMN - A values entry does not match the format for its filterType.

8169.meaning: INVALID WINDOW TYPE FOR THE COLUMN - windowFunction.type or movingCalculation.calculation is not a valid value.

8170.meaning: INVALID AXIS TYPE FOR THE REPORT - An axis type is not valid for the chosen reportType.

8173.meaning: The number of columns in bulk mode exceeds the allowed limit.
8173.resolution: Reduce the number of columns per request or split into multiple calls.

8174.meaning: DUPLICATETAGNAMEFOUND — A tag with this name already exists in the workspace.
8174.resolution: Choose a different name, or reuse the existing tag's ID.

8175.meaning: No embed URL on this view matches the supplied rsConfig.
8175.resolution: Re-read the current keys via Fetch All Embed URLs.

8176.meaning: deleteAllUrls was requested but the view has no embed URLs.
8176.resolution: Confirm the view has outstanding URLs via Fetch All Embed URLs with includeExpiredUrls: true.

8177.meaning: MAXALLOWEDVALUEEXCEEDED — validityPeriod exceeds the maximum of 86400 seconds (1 day).
8177.resolution: Send a value of 86400 seconds or less.

8178.meaning: Both rsConfig and deleteAllUrls: true were sent, or neither was.
8178.resolution: Send exactly one of the two.

8179.meaning: DONTHAVEPERMISSIONTOCREATETAGS — The caller is not an Account Admin, Organization Admin, or Workspace Admin.
8179.resolution: Call as an administrator of the workspace.

8180.meaning: DONTHAVEPERMISSIONTOASSOCIATEANDUNASSOCIATETAGS — The caller is a read-only user.
8180.resolution: Associations cannot be changed by read-only users.

8181.meaning: TAGCOUNTEXCEEDS — One or more views would exceed 10 tags. The message lists them.
8181.resolution: Remove tags from those views first, or drop them from the batch.

8182.meaning: resetSort: true and sortOrder cannot be used together.
8182.resolution: Use either resetSort: true (with no other fields) or columns + sortOrder (without resetSort).

8183.meaning: SCHEDULEIDNOTASSOCIATEDWITHCONNECTOR — The syncIntervalId does not belong to this datasource.
8183.resolution: Use a syncIntervalId listed under this datasource's syncIntervals.

8184.meaning: VIEWORTAGNOTPRESENTINDBTOTAG — The tag does not exist in this workspace.

8185.meaning: CANNOTDELETEORUPDATETAG — The update matched no row.

8187.meaning: ADVFILTER_EXPRESSION_ORDER_CHANGE - Criteria indexes in wildcard.expression are out of order.

8188.meaning: EXPORTINVALIDPASSWORD — password is blank or shorter than 6 characters.

8192.meaning: TRUSTED_DOMAINS_WITHOUT_DOMAIN_RESTRICTION - trustedDomains was sent for a section whose domain restriction is off or is being switched off.
8192.resolution: Send domainRestrictionEnabled: true with the list, or send domainRestrictionEnabled: false with trustedDomains: [] to clear it.

8193.meaning: TRUSTED_DOMAINS_EMPTY - The domain restriction is on, or being switched on, but the section has no trusted domains.
8193.resolution: Send at least one domain in trustedDomains, or switch the restriction off.

8194.meaning: DOMAIN_RESTRICTION_NOT_ALLOWED_WHEN_DISABLED - Domain attributes were sent for privateLinks, publicViews or emailViews while that feature is disabled or is being disabled.
8194.resolution: Enable the feature in the same request, or remove the domain attributes.

8195.meaning: EMAIL_NOT_ALLOWED_WHEN_EXPORT_DISABLED - emailViews was sent while export is disabled or is being disabled, and email views would stay enabled.
8195.resolution: Enable export in the same request, or send emailViews: {"enabled": false} when disabling export.

8196.meaning: ACCESS_RESTRICTION_DISABLED - Access restriction is off for the organisation and the request carries sections without turning it on, including accessRestrictionEnabled: false sent with sections while it is already off.
8196.resolution: Include accessRestrictionEnabled: true in the same request.

8197.meaning: ORG_ACCESS_RESTRICTION_NOT_ENABLED - The organisation's accessRestrictionEnabled is false.
8197.resolution: Enable access restrictions for the organisation with Update Org Access Restrictions, then retry.

8198.meaning: SECTIONS_NOT_ALLOWED_WHEN_APPLYING_ORG_SETTINGS - useOrganizationSettings: true was sent together with a non-empty section.
8198.resolution: Send useOrganizationSettings: true on its own.

8199.meaning: WORKSPACE_SETTINGS_NOT_ENABLED - The workspace follows the organisation, and the request would update it without useOrganizationSettings: false.
8199.resolution: Send useOrganizationSettings: false in the same request to give the workspace its own settings.

8200.meaning: SECTIONS_NOT_ALLOWED_WHEN_DISABLING_ACCESS_RESTRICTION - accessRestrictionEnabled: false was sent together with a non-empty section.
8200.resolution: Send accessRestrictionEnabled: false on its own.

8201.meaning: INVALIDCONFIGURATIONREMOVEVIEWSLINKEDWITHTAG — viewIds is empty or absent and dissociateAll is not true.
8201.resolution: Send a non-empty viewIds, or set dissociateAll to true.

8202.meaning: INVALIDCONFIGURATIONREMOVETAGSFORVIEW — tagIds is empty or absent and dissociateAll is not true.
8202.resolution: Send a non-empty tagIds, or set dissociateAll to true.

8241.meaning: SYSTEMTAGDATAWARNINGV2VALIDATIONCONFIRMATION — The view carries a restricted DATAWARNING system tag.
8241.resolution: Review the warning, then resend with "validateSystemTags": false to confirm.

8245.meaning: BACKUP_NOT_FOUND - The backup does not exist, or does not belong to this workspace.
8245.resolution: Take the backupId from Get Workspace Backups for the same workspace.

8246.meaning: INVALID_MASTER_WORKSPACE_MAPPING - <workspace-id> is itself linked as a client of another master.
8246.resolution: Use a workspace that is not already a client; a workspace cannot be both.

8247.meaning: LINK_WORKSPACES_INCOMPATIBLE_WORKSPACES - At least one candidate failed the compatibility check. Nothing was linked.
8247.resolution: Read data.incompatibleWorkspaces, resolve the conflicts or drop those workspaces, and resend.

8248.meaning: SANDBOX_NOT_MAPPED_TO_MASTER_WORKSPACE - One or more sandboxIds are not linked to this master. The message names them.
8248.resolution: Use sandbox IDs from Get Linked Workspaces For Master Workspace.

8249.meaning: INVALID_CONFIGURATION_REMOVE_LINKED_WORKSPACES - sandboxIds was supplied with scope: "ALL", or omitted with scope: "SELECTED".

8250.meaning: INVALID_UF_COMP_TYPE - compType is not valid for the column category or operation.
8250.resolution: See User Filter Rules by Column.

8251.meaning: INCORRECT_DATE_VALUE - A date in a date-range static filter could not be parsed.
8251.resolution: Use the date formats in Filter Value Formats.

8253.meaning: RESTORE_ALREADY_IN_PROGRESS - A restore is running for this workspace.

8254.meaning: INVALID_VALUE_FOR_ATTRIBUTE_FOR_COLUMN - latitude / longitude on a text column, or a place role on a numeric column.

8255.meaning: INVALID_KEY_GIVEN - operation: "geo" on a column type that cannot be geocoded.
8255.resolution: Use a Plain Text, Number, Positive Number, Decimal Number or Geo column.

8256.meaning: GEO_COL_COUNT_EXCEEDED - More than one text geo column on X, or more than one numeric geo column on one axis.
8256.resolution: Keep one geo column per axis.

8257.meaning: GEO_COL_COUNT_EXCEEDED_CATEGORICAL - A text geo column on X coexists with a numeric geo column on Y.

8258.meaning: GEO_COL_CATEGORY_ONLY_X - A text geo column was placed on a shelf other than X.

8507.meaning: MORETHANMAXLENGTH — roleName exceeds 30 characters, or permissions exceeds its size limit.

8509.meaning: PATTERNNOTMATCHED — roleName contains disallowed characters, or accessType is not one of the three values.

8516.meaning: UNABLETOPARSEDATATYPE — A CONFIG value has the wrong JSON type.

8517.meaning: DATATYPE_NOT_MATCHED - A value has the wrong JSON type: exclude: "yes", isAxisMerge: 1, folderId: "abc".
8517.resolution: Use JSON booleans, numbers and strings as documented.

8525.meaning: URLRULENOTCONFIGURED — <role-id> is not numeric, so the request matched no route.

8534.meaning: JSONPARSEERROR — CONFIG is not valid JSON.
8534.resolution: Fix the JSON and URL-encode it correctly.

8535.meaning: The OAuth access token is missing, expired, revoked, or does not carry the scope required by this operation.
8535.resolution: Regenerate the access token with the required scope (see the endpoint document) and retry.

8539.meaning: CONFIG is sent empty, or a CONFIG value - searchKey, pageNo, recordsPerPage, workspaceIds or one of its entries - is null or an empty or blank string.
8539.resolution: Leave the key out instead of sending an empty value, and send only non-empty workspace IDs.

8542.meaning: CONFIG holds a key other than workspaceIds, pageNo, recordsPerPage and searchKey.

8544.meaning: OUT_OF_RANGE - An integer is outside its range: percentileVal outside 0-100, a mergeAxisInfo index outside 0-100.
8544.resolution: Use a value inside the range.

8547.meaning: ARRAYSIZEOUTOFRANGE — selectedColumns is empty or holds more than 300 entries.
8547.resolution: Send between 1 and 300 column names, or omit the attribute.

9001.meaning: Every card in the layout is a USERFILTERS card.
9001.resolution: Add at least one content-bearing card.

9102.meaning: LANGUAGENOTSUPPORTED — language is not one of the supported language names.
9102.resolution: Use a value from language Values.

12049.meaning: The workspace is already enabled for White Label domain access. Calling Enable on an already-enabled workspace is not idempotent.
12049.resolution: Check the current domain access state before calling. Use Disable first if you need to re-enable (e.g., after domain reconfiguration).

12050.meaning: The workspace is not currently enabled for White Label domain access. Calling Disable on an already-disabled workspace is not idempotent.
12050.resolution: Verify the current state before calling. Only call Disable on workspaces previously enabled via Enable Workspace for Domain Access.

12052.meaning: WORKSPACENOTENABLEDFORDOMAINACCESS — The workspace is not enabled for access through the requested portal domain.
12052.resolution: Enable the workspace for that Client Portal domain first.

14037.meaning: DISABLED_COLUMNS_USED - A disabled column is used in the report.
14037.resolution: Enable the column, or remove it.

15007.meaning: The copy operation is not allowed — the destination workspace's organisation does not match the caller's organisation, and no valid workspaceKey was supplied (or it does not match).
15007.resolution: Supply the correct workspaceKey for the destination workspace (see Get Workspace SecretKey), or perform the copy within the same organisation.

18055.meaning: DBTYPESERVICENAMENOTMACHED — The databaseType is not available for the given serviceName.
18055.resolution: Pick an engine the service actually offers.

18056.meaning: NOSOURCEAVAILABLEFORTABLE — The table has no datasource behind it.
18056.resolution: Refetch only tables fed by a datasource; use the import APIs otherwise.

18057.meaning: INVALIDCLOUDSERVICENAME — serviceName is not a recognised service.
18057.resolution: Send a value from serviceName values.

18061.meaning: CONNECTIONIDNOTASSOSIATEDFORWORKSPACE — The datasource ID does not exist in this workspace, or the source type cannot be synced this way (HTTP 404).

18063.meaning: DBTYPECANNOTBEUPDATEDFORLIVECONNECTDB — databaseType differs from the stored one on a Live Connect database.

18064.meaning: SERVICENAMECANNOTBEUPDATEDFORLIVECONNECTDB — serviceName differs from the stored one on a Live Connect database.

18072.meaning: TABLESYNCINPROGRESS — A sync for this table is already running.
18072.resolution: Wait for it to finish, then retry.

18073.meaning: DATASOURCESYNCINPROGRESS — A sync for this datasource is already running.
18073.resolution: Wait for the running sync to finish.

70320.meaning: USERVARIABLEVARIABLENOTFOUND — <variable-id> does not exist in this workspace.

70321.meaning: USERVARIABLEVARIABLEINUSE — The variable is currently referenced elsewhere and cannot be deleted.
70321.resolution: Remove all references to this variable (in formulas, filters, SQL queries) before deleting.

70322.meaning: USERVARIABLEVARIABLEINUSE (multi-variable form) — One or more of the requested variables are in use.
70322.resolution: Same as above; applies when multiple variables are targeted in a single internal delete operation.

70323.meaning: DUPLICATEUSERVARIABLE — A variable with this name already exists in the workspace.
70323.resolution: Choose a different variableName, or edit the existing variable instead.

70325.meaning: INVALIDVARNAME — The name uses a reserved pattern (system. prefix, ${ prefix, or } suffix).
70325.resolution: Choose a name that doesn't collide with system-variable syntax.

70326.meaning: CANTDELETEVARIABLE — The variable cannot be deleted by this user (ownership restriction).
70326.resolution: Ensure the user is an Account Admin, Organization Admin, or Workspace Admin.

70329.meaning: CANTDELETEVARIABLE (UNAUTHORIZEDVARACTION) — <variable-id> does not exist in this workspace.

70335.meaning: VARIABLERANGENOTALLOWEDONDT — Range type combined with Text data type.
70335.resolution: Use a numeric variableDataType (4, 5, 6, 7, or 8) when variableType is Range.

70336.meaning: VARIABLEDATANOTPRESENT — No usable value entries could be derived from the request.
70336.resolution: Ensure defaultData (and any userSpecificData entries) contain the required fields for the chosen variableType.

70337.meaning: VARIABLEDEFAULTVALUENOTPRESENTINLIST — The defaultValue is not one of the values supplied for a List-type entry.
70337.resolution: Ensure defaultValue matches one of the entries in values.

70338.meaning: VARIABLERANGEINSUFFICIENTDATA / VARIABLERANGEEXCESSDATA — Range entry is missing a required field or has extra unexpected data.
70338.resolution: Ensure exactly minValue, maxValue, and stepSize are provided for Range entries.

70339.meaning: VARIABLERANGEINSUFFICIENTDATA / VARIABLERANGEEXCESSDATA — Range entry is missing a required field or has extra unexpected data.
70339.resolution: Ensure exactly minValue, maxValue, and stepSize are provided for Range entries.

70340.meaning: VARIABLERANGEDEFAULTVALUEOUTOFRANGE / VARIABLERANGEDEFBWMINMAXRANGE — The defaultValue falls outside [minValue, maxValue].
70340.resolution: Ensure defaultValue lies within the specified range.

70341.meaning: VARIABLEDUPLICATEMAILIDORGROUP — The same email address appears in more than one userSpecificData entry.
70341.resolution: Ensure each email address is listed in only one override entry.

70342.meaning: VARIABLEALLVALUESNOVARIABLEDATA — userSpecificData/defaultData were supplied for an All Values-type variable.
70342.resolution: Omit defaultData and userSpecificData entirely when variableType is 3.

70343.meaning: VARIABLENOVARIABLEDATAPRESENT — defaultData is missing for a List or Range-type variable.
70343.resolution: Supply defaultData with the fields required for the chosen variableType.

70348.meaning: VARIABLEEMAILNOTPRESENT — A userSpecificData entry has an empty emailIds array.
70348.resolution: Ensure every userSpecificData entry lists at least one email address.

70350.meaning: VARIABLEINVALIDVARTYPE — variableType is not one of 0, 1, or 3.
70350.resolution: Use only List (0), Range (1), or All Values (3).

70351.meaning: VARIABLEINVALIDDATATYPE — variableDataType is not one of the six supported values.

70352.meaning: VARIABLERANGEMINLESSTHANMAX — minValue is not less than maxValue.

70353.meaning: VARIABLERANGEINCRLESSTHANRANGESIZE — stepSize is larger than the range span.
70353.resolution: Reduce stepSize so it fits within maxValue - minValue.

70355.meaning: VARIABLERANGEINCRDIVEQUALLYERR — stepSize does not evenly divide the range span.
70355.resolution: Choose a stepSize that evenly divides maxValue - minValue.

70356.meaning: VARIABLERANGEDEFAULTVALUEOUTOFRANGE / VARIABLERANGEDEFBWMINMAXRANGE — The defaultValue falls outside [minValue, maxValue].
70356.resolution: Ensure defaultValue lies within the specified range.

70357.meaning: USERVARIABLEVARIABLECANNOTBEDELETED — Deletion blocked due to unresolved references.
70357.resolution: Identify and remove dependent formulas/reports, then retry.

70358.meaning: VARIABLECANNOTBEUPDATED — The requested type/data type change conflicts with existing formula/report references to this variable.
70358.resolution: Remove or update the dependent formulas/reports first, or keep the existing variableType/variableDataType.
